question:
Select the word similar in meaning to the given word.

Skip
solution:
The correct answer is **'Overlook.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Skip' **in English means to pass over or miss out on something. **('छोड़ना' or 'नजरअंदाज करना.')**

 
 
• **For example,** "I decided to skip lunch today".
 
 
 
• 'Overlook' means failing to notice or deliberately ignoring something. **('ध्यान न देना' or 'नजरअंदाज करना.')**
 
 
• **For example, **"The manager overlooked the error in the report,"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Insert'** means to place or put something within something else. **('सम्मिलित करना' or 'डालना.')**
 
• **'Notice' **refers to the act of observing something or bringing attention to something. **('ध्यान देना' or 'सूचना.')**
 
• **'Introduce'** means to present or make familiar with someone or something new.** ('परिचय कराना.')**
